subject: Project update after your note
text:
Following up on your earlier reply, the shared folder now has the revised survey questions and the draft timeline. Two neighbors confirmed they can attend the next meeting, and the venue contact said parking is available after six. The main open item is the printable handout, which is waiting on final budget approval. I’ll send a reminder to the email list once that is settled. If the timeline changes, please let me know soon.
Thanks,
Alex
